name: gupax
description: Browser-based Monero mining — P2Pool + XMRig GUI with optional Tor

paths.name: Gupax config
paths.description: Gupax configuration and state (wallet, settings persist here)

paths.name: Gupax share
paths.description: Downloaded mining binaries (P2Pool, XMRig, monerod) — persist across container updates

paths.name: Monero blockchain
paths.description: Monero blockchain data. In Gupax UI, go to Node tab and set database path to /home/miner/.bitmonero

paths.name: Tor keys
paths.description: Tor hidden service keys (keeps the same .onion address across container restarts)

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: noVNC web interface - connect your browser here

ports.name: VNC
ports.description: VNC server — disabled by default. Only enable if VNC_AUTH_TOKEN is set (exposing unprotected VNC gives full GUI control)

ports.name: P2Pool Stratum
ports.description: P2Pool Stratum - Connect external miners here

variables.name: TOR_ENABLED
variables.description: Enable Tor hidden service for Monero transaction broadcast (tx-only mode, P2P sync stays on clearnet)

variables.name: VNC_AUTH_TOKEN
variables.description: Password for VNC web interface access (leave empty for no authentication)

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file permissions (Unraid default: 99)

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for file permissions (Unraid default: 100)

variables.name: SCREEN_RESOLUTION
variables.description: Display resolution for Gupax GUI inside the container (default: 1920x1080x24)

variables.name: MONERO_RPC_RESTRICTED
variables.description: Restrict RPC to safe, view-only commands (default: true). Set to false only if you need full RPC access for external wallets.
